summary: Defines SNMP managed objects for bridges, devices that connect separate LAN segments, based on what was then the draft IEEE 802.1d standard. It was later replaced by RFC 1493 and RFC 1525.

eli5.summary: A list of questions you can ask a network bridge, like how many messages it has passed along. It lets one program check bridges from many companies in the same way.

questions: how to manage lan bridges with snmp
